links.outcome: Reading grade level of chatbot responses to adrenal nodule questions versus recommended patient education level
links.effect: Mean Lexile reading level was 8th-10th grade; all responses exceeded recommended patient education levels.
links.quote: More accurate, reliable, and thorough answers contained excess jargon, but all responses exceeded recommended patient education levels.

links.outcome: Jargon use and readability of chatbot responses to patient questions
links.effect: Jargon use differed significantly (p ≤ 0.05); Perplexity, the most accurate, used the most jargon; Gemini used the least. All responses exceeded recommended patient levels.
links.quote: More accurate, reliable, and thorough answers contained excess jargon, but all responses exceeded recommended patient education levels.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, reliability, and readability of responses from multiple generative AI chatbots to adrenal nodule questions using expert surgeon reviewers.
